summary: First-iteration full test of not4sale marketing site. Backend: all 8 pytest cases pass (health, contact create, contact validation, leads list ordering, chat (Claude Sonnet 4.5 live Italian reply), chat history persistence, chat invalid payload, sitemap.xml). Frontend: home/servizi/all 10 service detail pages, /contatti form submission (success state shown + lead persisted), AI chat widget (Italian reply received), navigation to /case-studies and /chi-siamo, and 404 page all render correctly. No critical issues found.

issues: Console warning from Lenis: 'Please ensure that the container has a non-static position, like relative, fixed, or absolute to ensure scroll offset is calculated correctly.' Cosmetic only; not blocking.

action_items: Optional: add `position: relative` (or similar) to the Lenis wrapper container to silence the Lenis scroll-offset console warning.

Optional QA-only note: Playwright's first pointer click on the floating AI chat toggle button needed force/JS fallback to register; real users not impacted (CustomCursor uses pointer-events-none, target z-index is 9700). No fix needed.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses `logger` inside chat() but `logger` is defined AFTER `app.include_router(api_router)` and after the route registration (lines 263 vs 193). Works because logger is resolved at call-time, but consider moving logging.basicConfig and logger declaration to the top of the file for clarity.
server.py uses `@app.on_event('shutdown')` which is deprecated in FastAPI; prefer `lifespan` context managers in future refactors.
ContactForm: phone/company/budget fields are sent to backend but no client-side validation for phone format. Acceptable since backend accepts optional strings.

AIChat: history is replayed via system-prompt transcript on each call; this works but token usage grows with conversation length; consider trimming to last N turns (already capped at 10 in backend, good).
Backend list_leads: hard-coded `limit` default of 100 is fine for MVP; consider pagination for production.
Backend chat persistence: each call instantiates a fresh LlmChat object; in-memory library history is unused since we reconstruct context from Mongo. This is fine and intentional per code comment.
test_credentials: Not applicable - no auth in this app
seed_data_creation: Created 1 TEST_ prefixed lead via /api/contact during backend testing and 1 additional lead via /contatti UI submission. Created 1 chat session with 2 messages via /api/chat. These can be left as-is or cleaned by main agent.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite is at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (pytest, 8 tests, ~9s runtime). It reads REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env if env var not set. Frontend has full data-testid coverage for all interactive elements. AI chat toggle floats at bottom-right z-9700; if Playwright click fails on first try, dispatch via page.evaluate JS click. Service slugs verified: seo, aeo, geo, growth-hacking, brand-strategy, performance-marketing, social, content, web-design, ai-marketing.
rca of the issue: No bugs to RCA. All flows green on first iteration.
